product: Redesigned MLflow Logs tab for AI Runtime runs
tagline: The MLflow run page Logs tab for AI Runtime runs now supports searching and filtering logs by node, level, and time range, following a running workload as new output arrives, and downloading logs.
what_it_does: The MLflow run page Logs tab for AI Runtime runs now supports searching and filtering logs by node, level, and time range, following a running workload as new output arrives, and downloading logs. For new runs, it replaces the log files previously stored on the run's Artifacts tab, which are deprecated. Logs are available for 60 days.
why_it_matters: For checkpointing patterns, see Improve training performance and resiliency on AI Runtime.
